meta.notice: SAMPLE DATA. Coordinates, hours, fees and amenities are best-effort estimates and have NOT been verified on site. Check every field (especially the ones listed in each entry's 'verify' array) before launch.

schemaNotes.type: One of: park, garden, trail, scenic area. Trails and scenic areas are treated as unsafe after sunset in the fit check.
schemaNotes.environment: Any of: quiet, scenic, water, forest, garden, open field.
schemaNotes.activities: Activities this place is genuinely good for. Any of: relaxing, walking, hiking, exercise, picnic.
schemaNotes.visitMinutes: Per activity: min = shortest visit that is still worth it (used by the fit check), typical = a normal visit. 'default' is used for activities not listed.
schemaNotes.hours: open / close are 'HH:MM' (24h), 'sunrise', 'sunset', or an offset like 'sunset+30'. closedDays uses sun, mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat.
schemaNotes.exposure: exposed | partial | sheltered. How much bad weather (rain, sun, wind) affects a visit.
schemaNotes.photo: URL of a photo you have rights to use. Leave empty to show the built-in illustration.

area.name: San Jose, CA
area.zipNote: Approximate ZIP centroids (lat/lng) for the San Jose area. These are rough. Replace with Census ZCTA centroids before launch.

destinations.name: Plaza de César Chávez
destinations.address: Market St & Park Ave, San Jose, CA 95113
destinations.accessibility: Flat, paved paths, wheelchair friendly. Crowded during downtown events.
destinations.description: A palm- and tree-lined downtown plaza with a splash fountain. The quickest patch of green near SJSU when you only have half an hour.

destinations.name: Guadalupe River Park & Trail
destinations.address: Arena Green, W Santa Clara St & Autumn St, San Jose, CA 95110
destinations.accessibility: Paved, mostly flat multi-use trail along the river. Shared with bikes.
destinations.description: A paved river trail that runs through downtown, with lawns, a carousel and sycamore shade. Easy for a quick walk or run between classes.

destinations.name: San Jose Municipal Rose Garden
destinations.address: Naglee Ave & Dana Ave, San Jose, CA 95126
destinations.parkingNote: Free street parking on Naglee & Dana Ave
destinations.accessibility: Mostly flat lawn and paved paths. Some gravel.
destinations.description: Thousands of roses on 5.5 acres around a central fountain. Best from April to September, and calm on weekday mornings.

destinations.name: Japanese Friendship Garden
destinations.address: Kelley Park, 1300 Senter Rd, San Jose, CA 95112
destinations.accessibility: Paved and gravel paths with small bridges and gentle slopes. No pets or picnics inside the garden.
destinations.description: Koi ponds, waterfalls and arched bridges modeled on Okayama's Korakuen garden, about 10 minutes' drive from downtown.

destinations.name: Overfelt Botanical Gardens
destinations.parkingNote: Free lot off Educational Park Dr
destinations.accessibility: Paved paths with some grass and gentle hills.
destinations.description: A quiet 33-acre garden with the Chinese Cultural Garden, ponds and wildlife habitat. Usually uncrowded.

destinations.name: Emma Prusch Farm Park
destinations.address: 647 S King Rd, San Jose, CA 95116
destinations.accessibility: Flat lawns and paved paths. The barn area is uneven.
destinations.description: A 47-acre urban farm with a huge picnic lawn, community gardens, a rare-fruit orchard and roaming chickens.

destinations.name: Alum Rock Park
destinations.address: 15350 Penitencia Creek Rd, San Jose, CA 95127
destinations.accessibility: Paved paths near the visitor center. Most trails are steep dirt.
destinations.description: California's oldest city park: a wooded canyon along Penitencia Creek with old mineral springs, stone grottos and ridge-top views.

destinations.name: Almaden Lake Park
destinations.parkingNote: Lot on Coleman Rd (fee may apply)
destinations.accessibility: Flat paved loop around the lake that connects to the Los Alamitos Creek Trail.
destinations.description: A 32-acre lake with a flat loop path, waterbirds and lawns. Easy to reach from the Almaden light-rail stops.

destinations.name: Santa Teresa County Park
destinations.address: Pueblo Day Use Area, 260 Manila Dr, San Jose, CA 95119
destinations.accessibility: Hilly dirt trails with very little shade. Bring water.
destinations.description: Rolling golden hills with views across the whole valley. In spring the slopes turn green and fill with wildflowers.

destinations.name: Almaden Quicksilver County Park
destinations.address: Mockingbird Hill entrance, Mockingbird Hill Ln, San Jose, CA 95120
destinations.accessibility: Steep dirt fire roads and single-track. Not wheelchair accessible.
destinations.description: Oak woodland trails through an old mercury-mining district, with mine relics and quiet ridgelines.
